steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendor additions are permitted for the tenant.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Verify the product's variant is populated as specified.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Complete any remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Add the initial participant required to publish the event.
Publish the RFQ so it becomes live.
Verify the event reached its published project page.
Open the live RFQ's participant management screen.
Add another QA vendor to the live event, representing Vendor C.
Verify the newly added vendor is selected and has an Add Bid control while the event is live.
Verify the participant audience increased by exactly one vendor.
